case, audit, network, report, indicators, metrics.

Each concrete rule implements id(), kind(),
Future: CycleRule (R7) is one more subclass.
Default transition methods in CaseState throw
overrides only the transitions it allows:
+submit(command: ActionCommand, actor: Actor, justification: String): DispatchResult
+enqueue(command: ActionCommand, actor: Actor, justification: String): PendingAction
+reject(pendingId: String, reviewer: Actor, reason: String): void
